questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

My friend Meera and her mother __is visiting__ me this weekend.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**are visiting**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The subject of the sentence is "**My friend Meera and her mother**", which is **plural**.
 
• Therefore, **the verb must also be plural to agree with the subject**.
 
• "**Are visiting**" is the correct verb form for a plural subject.
 
• Using "**is visiting**" with a plural subject is grammatically incorrect.

Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence**: *My friend Meera and her mother are visiting me this weekend.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Several times I have visited the narrow, dirty streets where the poor live, and I grow hot and indignant to think that good people should be content to live in fine houses and become strong and beautiful, while others are condemned to live in hideous, sunless tenements and grow ugly, withered and cringing.

B. Dear little creatures, they crouch in my heart and haunt me with a constant sense of pain.

C. The children who crowd these grimy alleys, half-clad and underfed, shrink away from your outstretched hand as if from a blow.

D. In the country one sees only nature’s fair works, and one’s soul is not saddened by the cruel struggle for mere existence that goes on in the crowded city.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **DACB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence D** sets the initial tone by contrasting the serene beauty of the countryside with the harsh reality of the crowded city.
 
• **Sentence A** follows, providing a personal reflection on the speaker's visits to the impoverished areas, expressing indignation at the stark contrast in living conditions.
 
• **Sentence C** elaborates on the plight of the poor, specifically focusing on the children in grimy alleys, highlighting their physical and emotional struggles.
 
• **Sentence B** concludes the paragraph, by expressing the emotional impact of witnessing the suffering of the impoverished children, emphasizing a constant sense of pain.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

I’ve got __a lot of homeworks__ this weekend.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**a lot of homework**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Homeworks**" is not a correct usage of the word; it should be "**homework**".
 
• The word "**homework**" is generally considered an uncountable noun, and it **does not usually take a plural form**.
 
• When referring to a large amount of homework, it is more appropriate to use "**a lot of homework**" rather than "**a lot of homeworks.**"
 
• The use of "**a lot of homework**" maintains proper grammar and accurately conveys the idea of having a significant amount of schoolwork to complete over the weekend.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**His father praised him**."

• The sentence is in passive voice, where the **subject **(**he**) is receiving the **action **(**praise**) from the **object **(**his father**).
 
• To convert it to active voice, we need to make the **subject **(**his father**) the doer of the **action **and the **object **(**him**) the receiver of the action.
 
• Therefore, "**His father praised him**" is the correct active voice version of the given sentence.

Thus, the correct answer is **option 4**.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Many species of bamboo flower once in several years and then die.

B. The stem itself is hollow and is connected to a network of rhizomes, which spreads out beneath the surface of the soil.

C. Roots grow out of this network of rhizomes and help the plants to absorb and distribute food and water from the soil.

D. The bamboo is a variety of grass, with a woody, many-jointed stem.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **DBCA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence D** introduces the main topic by providing information about bamboo, describing it as a variety of grass with a woody, many-jointed stem.
 
• **Sentence B** follows, expanding on the structure of the bamboo stem and its connection to a network of rhizomes beneath the soil.
 
• **Sentence C** further elaborates on the role of roots growing from this network of rhizomes, explaining how they assist in absorbing and distributing essential nutrients from the soil.
 
• **Sentence A** concludes the paragraph by introducing an interesting fact about bamboo—that many species flower only once in several years before dying, adding an element of life cycle and uniqueness to the description.

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.
